title: Tile Calculation Methodology
overview: Tile calculations estimate quantity needed including waste for cuts and pattern matching. Different patterns (straight, diagonal, herringbone) have different waste factors.

methods.name: Straight Layout
methods.description: Standard grid pattern with minimal waste. Add 10% for cuts and breakage.

formula.name: Tile Count
formula.expression:
Tiles = (Area / Tile Area) × 1.10
Tile Area = Tile Length × Tile Width

methods.name: Diagonal Pattern
methods.description: Tiles laid at 45° angle. More cuts required, typically 15% waste.

footnotes: Larger tiles have fewer grout lines but more waste
Buy all tiles from same lot for color consistency
